decision_rule: this control decides nothing; it exists so a reader can re-derive every later number from raw output

inputs.what: the environment of record, by its lock sha256

metric: the raw units each input is read in, and the arithmetic that turns raw output into the card's unit

threshold.required: stated before any band is compared

af2_hours_from_seconds.rule: wall-clock seconds of one prediction call divided by 3,600

aux_hours_from_seconds.rule: wall-clock seconds of docking, interface analysis and writing the call-table row for one pair, divided by 3,600

md_ns_per_day_from_steps.engine_rate_line_example: Speed (ns/day) column of the reporter file, read beside the wall-clock figure
md_ns_per_day_from_steps.rule: steps times the timestep gives simulated femtoseconds; divided by the production wall-clock and scaled to 86,400 seconds

raw_values_in.note: this control holds worked examples only; the raw values live in the row files named here, which are written later in the run

storage_gib_from_bytes.rule: apparent bytes written by one run times 216 divided by 2 to the power 30
